lanes.name: DXP / Siebel CRM
lanes.hint: Journey, customer, account, cart, billing, order, documentation

lanes.name: Verification & Eligibility
lanes.hint: KYC / MOI identity and eligibility & credit control

lanes.name: Product, Number & SIM Systems
lanes.hint: Catalogue, UIM number and SIM inventory

lanes.name: Network, Billing & Notification
lanes.hint: OSM activation, billing activation, customer notification

nodes.label: MNP Port-In Journey Triggered
nodes.desc: A Retail Agent initiates a Mobile MNP Port-In request for a customer wanting to port an active mobile number in from another licensed operator (per BR-MNP-001: MNP Port-In shall be available only for eligible Consumer customers requesting portability of an active mobile number from another licensed operator).

nodes.label: Reuse: Journey & Session Mgmt
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("JSM") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Initiate MNP Port-In Journey
nodes.desc: The system shall allow a Retail Agent to initiate a Mobile MNP Port-In request.

nodes.label: Reuse: Customer ID & Verification
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("KYC") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer KYC Verification
nodes.desc: The system shall perform IDWise capture and MOI validation before progressing the MNP journey.

nodes.label: Reuse: Customer & Account Mgmt
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("CAM") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer Search and Creation
nodes.desc: The system shall search for an existing customer and create a new customer record if none exists.

nodes.label: Reuse: Eligibility & Credit Control
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("ECC") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: The system shall validate age, ID eligibility, blacklist status, collections status, dues threshold and line count before allowing journey progression.

nodes.label: Reuse: Billing Account Mgmt
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("BAM") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Billing Profile Creation
nodes.desc: The system shall capture billing account and billing profile details for postpaid MNP requests.

nodes.label: Reuse: Product Catalogue & Cart
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("QPC") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Capture Donor Details
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retail Agent to capture the donor customer ID, donor customer ID type, donor customer type, donor operator and donor subscription type for the MNP Port-In request.

nodes.label: Restrict Free/Star Number Selection
nodes.desc: The system shall not allow the Retail Agent to add any Free/Star Number in case of Port In Flag is marked true.

nodes.label: Capture MNP Number
nodes.desc: The system shall capture and validate the MSISDN format requested for Port-In and use it throughout the journey.

nodes.label: Reuse: SIM Management
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("SIM") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Reuse: Cart Validation & Checkout
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("CVC") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Reuse: Contract & Documentation
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("CAF") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: MNP Form Generation
nodes.desc: The system shall generate the MNP Port-In Form using the validated customer, donor, Port-In MSISDN, product and order details captured during the journey.

nodes.label: MNP Form Customer Signature
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the customer to review and sign the generated MNP Port-In Form before the order is submitted for portability processing.

nodes.label: Reuse: Payment & Inventory
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("PAY") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Reuse: Order Submission
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("ORD") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Add Port-In Details at Order Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall include the validated Port-In request type, Port-In MSISDN, donor details, scheduled Port-In date where applicable, and signed MNP Form references in the order-submission payload sent for portability processing.

nodes.label: Reuse: Notification & Feedback
nodes.desc: Note: The process will follow the same capability ("NOT") as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Wait for NPAS Approval
nodes.desc: The system shall place the Port-In order in Pending NPAS Approval state after submission.

nodes.label: Cancel Order (NPAS Rejection)
nodes.desc: The system shall cancel the MNP Port-In order and update the tracking record when NPAS rejects the Port-In request.

nodes.label: Order Cancellation Notification
nodes.desc: The system shall notify the customer when an MNP Port-In order is cancelled following an NPAS rejection, using the configured notification channel and customer-facing rejection message.

nodes.label: Quick Draft from Cancelled Order
nodes.desc: The system shall allow a Retail Agent to create a new Quick Draft from a cancelled MNP Port-In order, carrying forward reusable customer, billing, product, SIM and MNP details for review.

nodes.label: Order Submit (Quick Draft)
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retail Agent to submit the new MNP Port-In order created from a cancelled order after all mandatory details, validations and payment conditions have been completed.

nodes.label: Create MNP Number Inventory
nodes.desc: Upon NPAS approval, the system shall create the Port-In MSISDN inventory in UIM.

nodes.label: Associate Vodafone SIM
nodes.desc: Upon NPAS approval, the system shall associate the reserved SIM with the newly created MNP MSISDN inventory.

nodes.label: Calculate Confirmed Port-In Date
nodes.desc: The system shall calculate and record the Confirmed Port-In Date and activation window after NPAS approval. If approval is received before the configured cut-off on a working day, the confirmed window shall be 11:00 to 12:00 on that date; otherwise, it shall be 11:00 to 12:00 on the next working day.

nodes.label: Network Activation and Provisioning
nodes.desc: The system shall activate the Port-In MSISDN and provision the subscribed services after NPAS approval.

nodes.label: Update Activation Status to NPAS
nodes.desc: The system shall send the final Port-In activation and provisioning outcome to NPAS after network processing is completed for the approved MNP MSISDN.

nodes.label: Billing Update
nodes.desc: The system shall create or update billing entities and activate charging after network activation is completed.

nodes.label: Completion Notification
nodes.desc: The system shall send Port-In completion notification after activation and billing completion.

nodes.label: Journey Blocked (Ineligible)
nodes.desc: The customer is blocked from continuing the Port-In journey because the eligibility validation (age, ID, blacklist, collections, dues, line count) failed.

nodes.label: Port-In Rejected & Closed
nodes.desc: Terminal state for a Port-In order cancelled following NPAS rejection and not subsequently resubmitted via Quick Draft, per the Status_Model's Tracking Record 'Cancelled -> Terminal' and MNP Port-In Order 'Cancelled -> Terminal' transitions.

nodes.label: Port-In Completed & Closed
nodes.desc: Terminal state for a successfully completed Port-In: MSISDN active, billing active, customer notified, per the Status_Model's MNP Port-In Order 'Completed -> Closed -> Terminal' transition.

start.title: MNP Port-In Journey Triggered
start.does: Marks the start of a Mobile MNP Port-In journey.
start.needs: A customer requesting portability of an active mobile number from another licensed operator.
start.makes: A new MNP Port-In journey instance.
start.example: A Consumer customer visits a retail store asking to bring their existing mobile number to Vodafone Qatar.

jsm01.title: Reuse: Journey & Session Management
jsm01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's session/tracking-record handling unchanged.
jsm01.needs: The reused JSM capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
jsm01.makes: A journey and session context for the Port-In request.
jsm01.example: Same session/tracking mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

jsm02.title: Initiate MNP Port-In Journey
jsm02.does: Lets a Retail Agent start a Mobile MNP Port-In request.
jsm02.needs: Retail Agent action to begin the journey.
jsm02.makes: MNP journey created with tracking record and draft order reference.
jsm02.example: Agent selects "MNP Port-In" from the DXP journey launcher.

kyc01.title: Reuse: Customer Identification & Verification
kyc01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's KYC handling unchanged.
kyc01.needs: The reused KYC capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
kyc01.makes: A verification gate before journey progression.
kyc01.example: Same IDWise/MOI capture flow as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

kyc02.title: Customer KYC Verification
kyc02.does: Performs IDWise capture and MOI validation before the MNP journey can proceed.
kyc02.needs: Customer identity document via IDWise; MOI validation service.
kyc02.makes: Customer identity validated and eligibility to proceed established.
kyc02.example: Agent scans the customer's ID; system cross-checks it against MOI records.

cam01.title: Reuse: Customer and Account Management
cam01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's customer/account handling unchanged.
cam01.needs: The reused CAM capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
cam01.makes: A customer/account context ready for the Port-In order.
cam01.example: Same customer search/creation mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

cam02.title: Customer Search and Creation
cam02.does: Searches for an existing customer using ID Type and ID Number before creating a new record.
cam02.needs: Customer ID Type and ID Number.
cam02.makes: Customer Account and Contact records available for order processing.
cam02.example: Agent enters the customer's QID; system finds an existing Siebel CRM record or creates one.

ecc01.title: Reuse: Eligibility and Credit Control
ecc01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's eligibility/credit-control handling unchanged.
ecc01.needs: The reused ECC capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
ecc01.makes: An eligibility gate before journey progression.
ecc01.example: Same age/blacklist/collections check mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

ecc02.title: Customer Eligibility Validation
ecc02.does: Validates age, ID eligibility, blacklist status, collections status, dues threshold and line count.
ecc02.needs: Customer age, ID status, blacklist/collections result, outstanding dues, line count.
ecc02.makes: Ineligible customers blocked; eligible customers allowed to proceed.
ecc02.example: A customer flagged as In Collections is blocked from continuing the Port-In (BR-MNP-023).

bam01.title: Reuse: Billing Account Management
bam01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's billing-account handling unchanged.
bam01.needs: The reused BAM capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
bam01.makes: A billing-account context ready for the Port-In order.
bam01.example: Same billing-account mapping mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

bam02.title: Billing Profile Creation
bam02.does: Captures billing account and billing profile details for postpaid MNP requests (mandatory for Postpaid, not applicable for Prepaid, per BR-MNP-005).
bam02.needs: Billing account details for the customer.
bam02.makes: Billing Profile successfully associated to customer account.
bam02.example: Agent creates a new billing profile for a customer with no existing postpaid billing account.

qpc01.title: Reuse: Product Catalogue and Cart
qpc01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's product/cart handling unchanged.
qpc01.needs: The reused QPC capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
qpc01.makes: A cart ready for product/plan selection.
qpc01.example: Same plan/add-on eligibility mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

qpc03.title: Capture Donor Details
qpc03.does: Captures donor customer ID, donor customer ID type, donor customer type, donor operator and donor subscription type.
qpc03.needs: Donor operator details from the customer.
qpc03.makes: All mandatory donor details captured, validated for completeness and saved against the request.
qpc03.example: Agent records that the customer is porting from a named competing operator.

num03.title: Restrict Free/Star Number Selection
num03.does: Blocks Free/Star Number selection whenever the Port-In Flag is true.
num03.makes: Free/Star Number options hidden/unselectable when Port-In Flag is True.
num03.example: Agent cannot pick a premium Star Number for a Port-In order.

num01.title: Capture MNP Number
num01.does: Captures and validates the customer-provided MSISDN format for Port-In and uses it throughout the journey.
num01.needs: The MSISDN the customer wants to port in.
num01.makes: MNP number displayed in the order; cannot be changed during the journey.
num01.example: Agent enters the donor MSISDN; the system validates its format.

sim01.title: Reuse: SIM Management
sim01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's SIM handling unchanged.
sim01.needs: The reused SIM capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
sim01.makes: A Vodafone SIM reserved and associated (per BR-MNP-008) but kept inactive until NPAS approval.
sim01.example: Same SIM selection/reservation mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

cvc01.title: Reuse: Cart Validation and Checkout
cvc01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's checkout validation gate unchanged (per BR-MNP-009: prevents progression to payment/order submission until all mandatory validations pass).
cvc01.needs: The reused CVC capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
cvc01.makes: A validated cart ready for CAF generation.
cvc01.example: Same pre-payment validation gate mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

caf01.title: Reuse: Contract and Documentation
caf01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's CAF handling unchanged.
caf01.needs: The reused CAF capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
caf01.makes: A CAF-generation context ready for the MNP-specific form.
caf01.example: Same CAF template/signature mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

caf02.title: MNP Form Generation
caf02.does: Generates the MNP Port-In Form from validated customer, donor, MSISDN, product and order details.
caf02.makes: An MNP Form with a unique form number, displayed for review, stored against the order; blocked if mandatory data is missing.
caf02.example: System auto-fills the MNP Form once all donor and product details are complete.

caf03.title: MNP Form Customer Signature
caf03.does: Lets the customer review and sign the generated MNP Port-In Form.
caf03.needs: The generated MNP Form; customer's signature.
caf03.makes: Signed flag recorded True and signed form stored; order submission blocked if unsigned or signature capture fails.
caf03.example: Customer signs the MNP Form digitally in front of the Retail Agent.

pay01.title: Reuse: Payment and Inventory
pay01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's payment handling unchanged (per BR-MNP-011: applicable charges/deposits collected before submission, or a zero-value receipt generated if none are due).
pay01.needs: The reused PAY capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
pay01.makes: Payment completed (or zero-value receipt issued) ahead of order submission.
pay01.example: Same upfront-payment collection mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

ord01.title: Reuse: Order Submission
ord01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's order-submission handling unchanged.
ord01.needs: The reused ORD capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
ord01.makes: An order-submission context ready to carry Port-In-specific details.
ord01.example: Same order-routing mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

ord04.title: Add Port-In Details at Order Submission
ord04.does: Includes Port-In request type, MSISDN, donor details, scheduled date and signed MNP Form references in the order-submission payload.
ord04.needs: Validated Port-In details and signed MNP Form.
ord04.makes: Submitted order/outbound portability request carries the Port-In indicator, MSISDN, donor details, scheduled date and Form number; blocked if any mandatory detail is missing/invalid.
ord04.example: The outbound NPAS request payload is assembled with all captured Port-In fields.

not01.title: Reuse: Notification and Feedback
not01.does: Carries forward the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's notification handling unchanged.
not01.needs: The reused NOT capability from MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001.
not01.makes: A notification context ready for order-submission notifications.
not01.example: Same notification-template mechanics as an ordinary postpaid activation journey.

pst01.title: Wait for NPAS Approval
pst01.does: Places the Port-In order in Pending NPAS Approval state after submission; no activation activity starts until NPAS responds.
pst01.makes: Order held in Pending NPAS Approval; no inventory creation, SIM association, activation or provisioning is permitted at this stage.
pst01.example: The order sits in a waiting queue while NPAS processes the portability request.

pst02.title: Cancel Order (NPAS Rejection)
pst02.does: Cancels the MNP Port-In order and updates the tracking record when NPAS rejects the request.
pst02.makes: Order status set to Completed Rejected then Closed; Tracking Record set to Cancelled; customer notified.
pst02.example: NPAS rejects the port due to a donor-side mismatch; the order and tracking record are closed out.

not02.title: Order Cancellation Notification
not02.does: Notifies the customer of the cancellation following an NPAS rejection.
not02.needs: Cancellation event; mapped customer-facing rejection reason.
not02.makes: A notification containing the Port-In MSISDN, cancellation status and rejection reason sent to the configured recipient.
not02.example: Customer receives an SMS explaining why the port could not proceed.

ord02.title: Quick Draft from Cancelled Order
ord02.does: Lets a Retail Agent create a new Quick Draft from a cancelled order, carrying forward reusable details.
ord02.makes: A new draft order with a unique reference; reusable details copied; original order remains Cancelled; details reviewable before submission.
ord02.example: Agent retries the port for the same customer without re-entering all details.

ord03.title: Order Submit (Quick Draft)
ord03.does: Submits the new order created from a cancelled order once all mandatory details/validations/payment are complete.
ord03.needs: Completed mandatory details, validations and payment on the Quick Draft.
ord03.makes: New order submitted with a unique reference, forwarded for NPAS processing, moved to Pending NPAS Approval; original order remains Cancelled.
ord03.example: Agent resubmits the corrected Port-In request for NPAS review.

num02.title: Create MNP Number Inventory
num02.does: Creates the Port-In MSISDN inventory in UIM after NPAS approval.
num02.makes: MSISDN inventory successfully created and reserved in UIM.
num02.example: UIM records the ported-in number as active inventory.

sim02.title: Associate Vodafone SIM
sim02.does: Associates the reserved Vodafone SIM with the newly created MNP MSISDN inventory.
sim02.needs: Reserved SIM; newly created MSISDN inventory.
sim02.makes: SIM and MSISDN inventory relationship established successfully.
sim02.example: The customer's new SIM is linked to their ported-in number in UIM.

net01.title: Calculate Confirmed Port-In Date
net01.does: Calculates and records the Confirmed Port-In Date and activation window after NPAS approval.
net01.needs: NPAS approval timestamp; configured cut-off and activation window (11:00-12:00).
net01.makes: Confirmed Port-In Date/window saved against the MNP request and available to downstream activation processing.
net01.example: Approval arrives at 09:00 on a working day, before cut-off, so the window is set to 11:00-12:00 that same day; approval after cut-off rolls to the next working day's window.

net02.title: Network Activation and Provisioning
net02.does: Activates the Port-In MSISDN and provisions subscribed services after NPAS approval (only after MSISDN inventory creation and SIM association succeed, per BR-MNP-016).
net02.makes: Mobile service activated on the Vodafone network; provisioning completed successfully.
net02.example: The ported number goes live on the Vodafone network with the selected plan.

net03.title: Update Activation Status to NPAS
net03.does: Sends the final activation/provisioning outcome to NPAS after network processing completes.
net03.makes: NPAS receives the MNP MSISDN, NPAS reference number, final activation status and completion timestamp; update acknowledged.
net03.example: NPAS is informed the port completed successfully so it can close its own record.

fin01.title: Billing Update
fin01.does: Creates or updates billing entities and activates charging after network activation completes (only after successful network activation/provisioning, per BR-MNP-017).
fin01.makes: Billing activation completed successfully and linked to customer account.
fin01.example: Charging starts on the customer's account for the newly ported service.

not_final.title: Completion Notification
not_final.does: Sends the Port-In completion notification after activation and billing completion (only after successful MSISDN activation, provisioning and billing, per BR-MNP-018).
not_final.makes: Customer receives a successful Port-In completion notification through the configured channel.
not_final.example: Customer gets an SMS confirming their number is now active on Vodafone.

end_blocked.title: Journey Blocked (Ineligible)
end_blocked.does: Terminates the journey when the customer fails eligibility validation.
end_blocked.makes: Journey ends without a Port-In order being created.
end_blocked.example: A blacklisted customer's Port-In attempt is stopped before cart creation.

end_rejected.title: Port-In Rejected & Closed
end_rejected.does: Marks the terminal state of a rejected-and-cancelled Port-In journey.
end_rejected.makes: Journey ends in Cancelled/Closed terminal state.
end_rejected.example: Customer decides not to retry after an NPAS rejection.

end_complete.title: Port-In Completed & Closed
end_complete.does: Marks the terminal state of a successfully completed Port-In journey.
end_complete.makes: Journey ends in Completed/Closed terminal state.
end_complete.example: The customer's ported number is fully active and billed; the journey is closed.
